snippet.title: SIM: Day & Night Trilogy (Flash-Game) | Complete Story!
snippet.description:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kevintraian/

"SIM: Day and Night" is a life simulation flash-game, developed by a man named Gijs Besselink (also known online as silverburst) and it was released in July 23, 2003, on Newgrounds. Apart from broad similarities, it's unrelated to "The Sims" series of games. The game's somewhat comparable to the first Stick RPG game. Both games feature an unnamed player trying to work his way up the societal ladder in an unnamed small town with unsavory people. However, there's no backstory as to how the protagonist ended up in the town. There is however, a loose plot divided into 8 scenes and a cast of 10 characters. A demo was first published on Newgrounds on July 21, 2003. The full version, with additional content and bug fixes, was released 2 days later. In this flash-game, you can do lots of things you make daily basic things that you usually do in real-life such as : waking up, have a coffee at your favorite Coffee Shop, chit-chat & meet new people, go to School to learn new essential information & hit the gym, have a part-time job (in this case in a Hotel) to get some cash, so you can party all night if you want to go in the Disco Club of the town & meet some beautiful girls there. There's also a store called : "Supa Store" where you can go and buy for yourself some fancy clothes like: Worker Jeans, Modern Man & Hugo Boss, a new house such as : The New Family House, The Dream Villa or even The Castle. You can even buy a lovely Bouquet of flowers to give as a gift to girls, and a Coffee Maker like : Early Coffee & Supa Espresso. "SIM: Day and Night" is kinda infamous for its use of +18 images in the "Get Jiggy" scenes, where the player can try to score a date at the nightclub. But, you won't get to see those on my walkthrough, 'cuz after all, we're on YouTube here, lol. Want more content like this? Then don't forget to leave a LIKE, COMMENT & SUBSCRIBE TO THE CHANNEL!

Credits: Gijs Besselink aka. silverburst.
Play it here: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/111276

Video made by: #kevinutx
